title: IN WHICH FIX, THE DETECTIVE, CONSIDERABLY FURTHERS THE INTERESTS OF PHILEAS FOGG
summary_hover: Fogg hires a wind-powered sledge to race to Omaha, catching trains to New York only to miss his Liverpool steamer by minutes.
summary_detail: Stranded and twenty hours behind schedule, Fogg accepts Fix's suggestion to hire a wind-powered sledge driven by an American named Mudge. The sledge races across the frozen plains to Omaha, where the party boards a series of trains to Chicago and then New York. Despite their rapid transit across the country, they arrive at the New York pier just 45 minutes after their steamer has sailed for Liverpool.
